newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amcor says to build new U.S. plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amcor says to build new U.S. plant.

text.p: Paper and packaging group Amcor Ltd said on Friday it planned to build a new dairy and food packaging plant in the United States at a cost of A$18.5 million.
"This investment represents a further extension of Amcor's North American packaging interest which are developing around (Canadian subsidiary) Twinpak," Amcor said in a statement.
Construction of the 100,000 square foot plant in Virginia would begin soon and it was expected to be completed by April 1997, the company said.
The plant, with an initial capacity of about 700 million units year, would supply the food and dairy service customers of Twinpak in the eastern region of North America, it said.
Twinpak, based in Montreal, is part of Amcor's Containers Packaging division and has 17 manufacturing operations and distribution centres across Canada.
At 0110 GMT (11.10 a.m.) Amcor shares were down four cents at A$7.61.
